data.narrative:
Fleet Space Technologies is a Series C-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $70M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of five public Space & Aerospace names (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and three same-sector, same-stage private comparables: Sierra Space ($8.0B), Varda Space Industries ($1.5B), and Skyryse ($1.1B).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using $70M total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, implies a valuation of $119M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-stage Space & Aerospace comparables yields $1.5B, with a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (median 23.9x across the five public names) cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue.

The triangulated range spans $101M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $810M. The wide dispersion—driven primarily by the outsized Sierra Space valuation within the peer set—reflects material uncertainty around Fleet Space's competitive positioning and path to scale. Stage-progression anchors a conservative floor, while peer comparables suggest substantially higher valuation if the target's market opportunity and execution trajectory align with higher-valued peers. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, customer concentration, and capital intensity of deployment.
